sql:
SELECT r.raceId, c.name AS circuit_name, MIN(r.time) AS lap_record
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
GROUP BY r.raceId, c.name
